name: core
description: Always-on working discipline for every project: mirror intent and hold brainstorm phases until an explicit greenlight, integrate reference code only through approved deviations, tag each project with its categories so domain plugins such as research load only where they belong, and keep one cross-project list of work (ReSirch Killalot) that agents propose into, only the owner accepts, and the owner manages in plain words from Telegram, the web app, or a connected chat app.

interface.shortDescription: Intent gating, project tags, cross-project work list
interface.longDescription: Skills that belong in every project. Mirror the user's request back before acting, and hold brainstorm phases with no plan or code until an explicit greenlight. Integrate reference implementations through protected, user-approved deviations. Tag a project with its categories in .project.toml and generate each host's per-project plugin enablement from it, so domain plugins such as research load only in the projects that use them. Keep every tagged project's tasks, decisions, approvals and reminders in one owner-controlled list (ReSirch Killalot): agents propose, the owner accepts from a terminal, a session, a paired phone, a Telegram bot, or a connected chat app, talks to the list in plain words (priorities, dependencies, comments included), and each session starts knowing what is open in its project.
defaultPrompt: Show me that you understood my request before doing anything, then hold in brainstorm phase until I greenlight the plan.
Tag this project as a research project so the research skills load here.
Port this reference implementation into my codebase and show me every deviation first.
What is waiting on me across my projects?
